memories.memory: Don't add a comment when a reader can understand the code without it.
Prefer immutable data and pure functions by default.
Name functions and methods after what they do, not how they do it.
Name variables after what they contain, not their type or a shortened alias.
Name things so a reader understands what they hold without reading surrounding code.
For an owned copy or a rebinding, reuse the same name.
Use abbreviations only when universally understood, such as `url`, `id`, or `i` for a loop index.
